name: Mason Jar Tex-Mex Beef Soup with Corn, Green Beans & Cilantro (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Divide salsa, bouillon cubes, and cumin between two (quart-sized) jars. (Make sure to add the correct amount of bouillon; each jar should have enough to make 3 cups of broth.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup salsa
¼ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add green beans and corn to the jars with the salsa mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup frozen green beans, pieces
1 cup frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Stack beef slices one on top of another, then medium dice and add to the jars.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the jars.
Wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the jars.
Roughly crush tortilla chips and add to the jars, packing gently if necessary.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)

When ready to eat, empty jar into a microwave safe bowl. Fill now-empty jar ⅔ full with water and add to the bowl. Microwave on high until veggies and beef are warmed through, about 6 minutes. Let sit 1 minute, then carefully remove from the microwave. (Alternatively, place jar contents and water in a medium saucepan, then stir to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 3-4 minutes.) Enjoy!
